For Mexico City Candidates: 

Please submit your resume in English - we can only consider applications submitted in this language.

Only applications of candidates with Mexican citizenship will be evaluated for this role in compliance with the provisions of Article 7 of the Federal Labor Law.


Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: Mexico City, CDMX, Mexico; Bengaluru, Karnataka, India.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 4 years of experience in data modeling, developing data sets, or creating data visualizations.
  • Experience writing SQL queries.
  • Experience using BI tools like Looker, Tableau, or Power BI to create visualizations and dashboards.

Preferred qualifications:

  • MBA, Master's degree, or advanced degree in a technical or scientific field of study.
  • Experience supporting data-driven sales operations, consulting, or program management and strategic cross-functional BI initiatives in a cloud business.
  • Experience with scripting languages such as Python, Go, JavaScript, or HTML for data manipulation, analysis, and automation.
  • Experience working with systems for collaborative code reviews including version control.
  • Experience developing AI agents.
  • Familiarity with statistical modeling, machine learning, or data mining techniques.

About the job

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.


The Performance and Continuous Excellence (PACE) Intelligence team is the global Business Intelligence (BI) foundation of Google Cloud, designed to accelerate sales growth through AI agents, advanced reporting, and streamlined performance management. We are responsible for building the semantic source of truth for the business, delivering reporting capabilities that serve over 10,000 sellers across the cloud Go-to-Market (GTM) organization. By empowering GTM and Regional teams with scalable insights, a resilient data layer, and innovative Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), we enable our sellers to deeply understand their book of business and bring the very best of Google to their customers. Ultimately, our mission is to drive business success and execute our cloud strategy through an insights-led ecosystem of dashboards, agents, and expert analysts.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Responsibilities

  • Transform data into actionable insights by developing data models, data marts, and automating reporting processes to provide leadership with a clear picture of key business and process performance.
  • Develop, test, and maintain AI agents that integrate with existing data pipelines to scale the generation and delivery of actionable business intelligence.
  • Develop data infrastructure, which includes building SQL scripts, creating data pipelines, data warehouses, crafting investigative models, and designing user-friendly dashboards.
  • Lead assigned projects from conceptualization to delivery and ensure your data solutions offer relevant, high-quality data and insights to propel the growth of the business.

gh_81101225f8f8a2c29de5c5b8.description:
岗位：高级测试开发工程师（区块链钱包方向）
工作地点：日本大阪
薪资范围：5,000–10,000 美金/月
语言要求：中文
工时：8 小时，周休 1 日
国籍：不限

工作职责
1. 参与产品及技术方案评审，识别资产、权限、状态机、幂等、并发及资料一致性风险。
2. 根据业务风险制定测试策略、测试计画、测试矩阵及发布标准。
3. 负责托管钱包、AA 钱包、理财、企业金库及多签业务的功能、API、整合及 E2E 测试。
4. 验证充值、提币、转帐、签名、广播、链上确认、链重组、交易替换及对帐等核心流程。
5. 负责 OIDC、SSO、SLO、JWT、Token 生命周期、多租户隔离及权限控制测试。
6. 建设及维护 API 自动化、链上场景自动化及关键业务 E2E 自动化测试。
7. 与后端、前端及智能合约开发共同完善单元测试、元件测试、Foundry 场景测试及 CI/CD 品质门禁。
8. 负责 PC、H5、iOS、Android 客户端关键流程的相容性及异常场景测试。
9. 设计重复请求、并发操作、RPC 故障、讯息乱序、回调重复、服务重启等异常测试。
10. 跟进及分析生产问题，推动事故复盘并将生产缺陷转化为自动化回归测试案例。
11. 建立缺陷管理、版本回归、品质指标及发布检查机制。
12. 推动研发团队建立共同承担品质责任的工程​​文化。

任职要求
1. 5 年以上软体测试或测试开发经验，特别优秀者不以年限为唯一标准。
2. 具备后端 API、分散式系统及资料一致性测试能力。
3. 熟悉 Go、TypeScript 或 Python 至少一门程式语言。
4. 能独立设计及编写稳定、可维护的自动化测试。
5. 熟悉 Linux、Git、Docker 及常见 CI/CD 流程。
6. 熟悉 HTTP、REST、JSON、WebSocket、Webhook 及 SQL。
7. 理解状态机、幂等、重试、逾时、并发、最终一致性及故障补偿。
8. 理解 EVM 交易生命周期，包括 Gas、Nonce、Receipt、Event、Confirmation、Revert、Reorg。
9. 具备权限安全、租户隔离及资产风险意识。
10. 能使用中文进行高品质技术沟通及文件撰写。
11. 能在需求不完整时主动推动产品及研发补充边界条件。

加分条件

1. 具备托管钱包、交易所、支付、清结算或金融帐务测试经验。
2. 具备 ERC-4337、智能帐户、Bundler 或 Paymaster 经验。
3. 具备多签、MPC、HSM 或企业金库经验。
4. 具备 Solidity、Foundry 测试经验。
5. 具备 OIDC、OAuth 2.0、SSO、SLO 测试经验。
6. 熟悉 Playwright、Appium、Detox 或 Maestro。
7. 具备效能测试、故障注入或基础安全测试经验。
8. 具备 DeFi、理财产品或链上资产管理经验。

不适合
1. 没有区块链测试经验。
2. 主要按照既有测试案例进行手动测试。
3. 不具备基本程式设计及自动化测试能力。
4. 只关注页面显示，不关注服务端状态及资料一致性。
5. 不理解幂等、并发、重试及非同步状态。
6. 对权限越权、租户隔离及资产风险不敏感。
7. 无法独立定位 API、资料库、日志及链上交易问题。

备注：
1. 公司为区块链基础设施公司。
2. 产品涵盖智能帐户钱包、托管钱包、数位资产理财、企业级数位资产金库、多签及风控系统。
3. 客户端包含 PC Web、H5、iOS、Android。
4. 后端主要使用 Go，智能合约使用 Solidity／Foundry，前端主要使用 JavaScript／TypeScript。
